adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true (lib/topic_retriever.rb). This runs the feed polling/import synchronously inside the `retrieve_topic` job path instead of enqueuing a separate Sidekiq job (e.g., `Jobs.enqueue(:poll_feed)`), so a user-triggered embed retrieval can cause the worker to parse the entire feed (`rss.items.each` in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) in-line and it won’t have separate job lifecycle/driver isolation. However, it’s not clearly a functional defect from the diff alone (and `sidekiq_options retry: false` also reduces the “retry semantics” impact), so it’s best classified as an architecture/performance concern rather than a verifiable bug.
